notes.title: Update #12 - 4 new levels, Localization & key mapping
notes.content:
Hi fellow knights,


It’s been a little bit longer since our last update. There will be fewer updates as we approach release, since most work is behind the scenes with various bug fixing etc.

We added 4 new levels and redid level 6. Which means tons of new fun to give a go if you have been playing the game for a while.

We also added two translations, Danish and French. We will add more at a later date.

Lastly we added a feature some of our players have been requesting, key binding which means you can change the current setup and make it your own. It should make it easier to be two players on one keyboard. 

We also fixed some bugs.

Stay Knightly !

notes.title: Update #11 - Story Mode
notes.content:
We are introducing a new mode in KnightOut, story mode! We are really excited since it’s something we have been working on for a long time. The enemies we added to arcade mode and the changes we did all lead up to this.

In the story mode you will enter Braal Kingdom, a kingdom which once had an abundance of riches with cup cakes and sweets but now struggles to afford even the smallest castles. One peasant decides to go on a journey to help the royals and rebuild their empire. You will play through several levels, gain more weapons to your arsenal and be rewarded with cup cakes that unlocks new worlds. It’s a single-player and co-op mode.We would love to hear your feedback on our discord channel.

Stay knightly

notes.title: Update #10 - Knightmare on Brawl Street
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DpbNVrNXt18;full][/previewyoutube][b]Celebrate Halloween with KnightOut's "Knightmare on Brawl Street" event.[/b]
Play anytime during the event to unlock spooky Halloween items for your knight. Every other day you play the game you will unlock new Halloween themed goodies.

We have retouched the environments and given them all a Halloween flare with spooky décor such as Jack-O'-Lanterns and spider webs.

It's the prefect time to enjoy the spooky vibes in KnightOut, alone or with a friend.

You will find the new enemy in arcade mode, it’s baby drakes that comes more often than regular drakes. They are easier to knock out but often attack in groups. Beware they are a challenge.

We would love your feedback on the new event and the changes. We would also like to encourage you to leave an honest review if you haven't done so already, it helps new players decide if they want to give KnightOut a go.

[b]What’s next?[/b]
We have some great updates coming up, and we will continue to update KnightOut until we release it. Which isn’t too far into the future now. We are really excited about bringing you new features.

[*] “Knightmare On Brawl Street” - Event started.

[*] Added a skeleton skin.
[*] Added halloween decorations to levels.
[*] Fixed bug where brute’s special attack are able to attack both directions.
[*] There is now a new enemy, baby drakes.
[*] Waves have been re-visited in arcade mode.
[*] Flying enemies now take more damage from melee.
[*] Wizard’s will now fly lower if there are no weapons on the field.
[*] Grunts can now attack downwards.
[*] Grunts now don't run in place when anticipating a new attack.
[*] Fixed bug where it wouldn’t show unlocked headgear in the profile menu.
[*] Fixed visual items on the leaderboards where the backplate didn’t align.
[*] Bear traps now open up after a wave in arcade.
[*] Added voices to brutes and grunts
[*] Added SFX to drakes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5 - Introducing Arcade Mode
notes.content:
The summer is upon us. What better way to spend a evening than firing up under KnightOut to keep your mind off that terrible sunburn you got.

KnightOut now features an arcade mode.
In arcade mode you will fight against hordes of enemies, singleplayer og co-op with a friend. We implemented Steam leaderboards so you can compete against us and other players which really gives it another dimension. Currently it features 3 different enemy types.

It’s a work in progress and we are actively working on it. We want to improve the AI and add more enemies that we already have been working on. The mode needs some more variety but we want you to get your hands on the mode as early as possible so we can get a better idea of how to take it further. With your help we can take the game mode to the next level, so please leave us your feedback.

We are celebrating this update with a 30% discount!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing KnightOut and for giving us feedback on the forum and discord.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Duplicate player bug is fixed: We now check if there is a player already on the map, if there is we can't spawn more.
[*] Explosion damage from cannons reduced from 150 to 49. Because the cannons needed to be balanced so it wasn’t only a battle of cannons.
[*] Restart tutorial is removed: There is a few bugs with this function but you can restart the tutorial if you go to main menu and then run it again.
[*] Increased wood walls vulnerability against explosions.
[/list]

[b]Stuck at loading screen:[/b]
If you get this bug we would be happy to hear how you got it. We have been trying to figure out where it comes from and how to fix it. We have done some adjustments, but the bug may still occur.

Feedback is as always very welcome.

notes.title: New items, GUI etc. - Version 0.2.5.7a
notes.content:
We just updated the game with some new changes. We added two new items, which we are still testing and the graphics are not final yet. We got some great feedback which we also implemented.

We also added a shield mechanic for the Knight, it has a duration of 3. Which means if you use your shield and the opponent hits your shield you can block 3 times.

[h1] Changelog:[/h1]
[b]Changes:[/b]
- We added control screen for keybaord
- New items: Bear Trap and Hatch
- Back button from player selection.
- Shield mechanic
- Updated build GUI
- We redid some of the cannon effects, they are still work in progress
- You can now sell items when you are building and get half the price back.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Respawn bug fixed. Sometimes the player wouldn't respawn.
- Knight Animation bugs are now fixed

notes.content:
We just updated the game with some new changes. We added two new items, which we are still testing and the graphics are not final yet. We got some great feedback which we also implemented.

We also added a shield mechanic for the Knight, it has a duration of 3. Which means if you use your shield and the opponent hits your shield you can block 3 times.

[h1] Changelog:[/h1]
[b]Changes:[/b]
- We added control screen for keybaord

- Back button from player selection.
- Shield mechanic
- Updated build GUI
- We redid some of the cannon effects, they are still work in progress
- You can now sell items when you are building and get half the price back.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Respawn bug fixed. Sometimes the player wouldn't respawn.
- Knight Animation bugs are now fixed
- Blocks not merging when build is now fixed.
- Ready text wouldn't disappear is also fixed.
- Deflect bug which meant deflect didn't work is now fixed.

We would love to hear your thoughts on the changes.
